title: 모바일 청첩장 읽기: 언제, 어디로 가요?
note: Made by the daily run on 2026-09-26 at three pages; read back by hand (checked identical to the English PDF) and shortened by hand.

manual.before: A short story about a friend's mobile wedding invitation. Learners find the time, place, transport, meal, and gift-account ('마음 전하실 곳') details.
manual.after: A friend's mobile wedding invitation: find the time, place, transport, meal and gift-account details.
manual.why: The sheet ran to three pages; shortened by hand to fit two in every language (same learning goal).
